name: playit.gg
tagline: playit.gg is a global proxy that allows anyone to host a server without port forwarding. We use tunneling. Only the server needs to run the program, not every player!
description: playit.gg is a global proxy that allows anyone to host a server without port forwarding. We use tunneling. Only the server needs to run the program, not every player!
compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-playitgg application
services:
  # Service name: app
  # The `app` service definition
  app:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: playitgg
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: dysta/playitgg:1.2.0@sha256:d26d21c5fca76253dbc45715f1556cdc29945648a11e0f63b01fb6a1c9b4a96a
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local playitgg directory to /secrets inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/secrets:/secrets
